description: Presidential Secretariat - Presidential Commission of Inquiry (Politically Victimized)
reasoning: This gazette establishes a Presidential Commission of Inquiry to investigate allegations of political victimization, amends the original warrant to include additional agencies, and outlines specific legal matters to be investigated. The content primarily deals with legal procedures, investigative mandates, and amendments to an existing legal instrument under the Commission of Inquiry Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter.
